pixelInventory.axes: One shared Cartesian frame. The horizontal axis extends a short distance left of its intersection with the vertical axis and has a rightward positive arrow. The vertical axis extends a short distance below the intersection and has an upward positive arrow. No negative-end arrow is visible.
pixelInventory.ticksAndGrid: No intentional scale ticks, numbered graduations, units or grid. Small irregular marks on the scanned strokes are print noise, not added ticks.
labels: I, at the upper left of the vertical positive end.
B with a subscript 0, below the horizontal positive end; no vector accent.
An italic zero-shaped origin glyph immediately below-left of the intersection, preserved as 0.
pixelInventory.curves: One continuous solid unmarked curve begins at the axes' intersection, rises steeply in the positive-positive quadrant, then becomes progressively flatter toward its right endpoint. It stops well before the horizontal-axis arrow. There is no return branch, curve arrow, explicit saturation marker, labelled point, horizontal asymptote, dashed curve or shaded region.
pixelInventory.relations: The curve shares the axes' origin, remains in the positive-positive quadrant, increases monotonically and approaches a nearly horizontal, nonzero terminal slope. Axes are perpendicular. Approximate source-screen positions are intersection (56,347) and curve endpoint (360,100); these are visual-location observations, not measured magnetic coordinates.
pixelInventory.culture: No portrait, apparatus, Cyrillic label, identity symbol or source caption inside this PNG.

sourceOpens.routingObservation: The actually opened assigned PNG contains two vertically stacked hysteresis graphs, not a Stoletov portrait or closed-ring apparatus. This records observed pixels, not a correction to sibling ownership.

pixelInventory.axes: Each panel has its own intersecting horizontal and vertical axes. Positive horizontal arrows point right and positive vertical arrows point up. The upper panel also has a downward arrow at the negative vertical end; the lower panel's negative vertical end has no clear arrow.
pixelInventory.ticksAndGrid: Neither panel has intentional scale ticks, numerical graduations, units or a grid.
pixelInventory.labels: Each panel has I by its positive vertical end, B with subscript 0 below the positive horizontal end, and a zero-shaped origin glyph below-left of the crossing. The upper and lower panels have Cyrillic a-like and b-like subfigure labels, respectively, near their lower-right portions.
pixelInventory.curves: The upper panel has a narrow solid two-branch loop with steep central branches close to the vertical axis; the branches converge at lower-left and upper-right ends. The lower panel has a much wider solid two-branch loop with larger horizontal intercept separations and larger vertical-axis intercept magnitudes. No curve arrows, named points, measured data or shading are visible.
pixelInventory.relations: The two panels are vertically stacked independent frames. Their qualitative loop widths, areas and intercepts differ. No calibrated quantitative comparison can be inferred from unnumbered pixel positions.
